name: Citizenship by Marriage (Sections 3(1), 3(3), 3A(1)(b), 6)

qualifying_event.description: A spouse of a Barbadian citizen may apply for Barbadian citizenship under Sections 3(1), 3(3), 3A(1)(b), and 6, via the Immigration Department.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Applicant's birth certificate; spouse's birth, baptism, and citizenship documents; marriage certificate.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being validly married to a Barbadian citizen, proven via the marriage certificate and the spouse's birth, baptism, and citizenship documents; any prior divorce or death (of a former spouse) must also be documented, and foreign-language documents must be translated.

evidence_required.document: Spouse's birth, baptism, and citizenship documents

sources.title: Barbados Immigration Department -- Barbadian Citizenship: by descent (Section 5(1)), by marriage, by registration/naturalisation, and Section 3(2), with required documents and fees

notes: NEW ROUTE, filling a gap flagged in bb_naturalisation.json's notes: that earlier pass found NO citizenship-via-marriage provision in the Cap. 186 text extracted from barbadoslawcourts.gov.bb, and explicitly flagged the absence as surprising for a Commonwealth Caribbean citizenship act. This route resolves that gap using the Immigration Department's own citizenship page, a different tier-1 source, which lists a marriage ground plainly under Sections 3(1), 3(3), 3A(1)(b), and 6. No specific minimum marriage duration or residence period is stated in the source reviewed -- unlike several other Commonwealth Caribbean countries in this dataset, no minimum-years-of-marriage figure was found here, so none was invented; this should be treated as an open detail rather than confirmation that no such requirement exists. dual_citizenship_allowed left null, consistent with bb_naturalisation's own unresolved flag on this point. Application fee: BBD$300; final fee if approved: BBD$1,500 (same fee structure as bb_citizenship_descent, per the same source page).
